title: CmdPal: Add a Performance Monitor Overview card and dock band

review.body_prefix:
### Review assessment

The unchanged-head assessment is retained, with an unresolved integration observation: a maintainer reported that Pin to actions appear for the overview page on a combined branch but do not produce a visible pin. The report explicitly leaves open whether that branch or this PR is responsible; it does not yet establish a defect in this PR.

**Validation scope:** The new discussion was checked against the unchanged source revision. The combined-branch pinning scenario has not been independently reproduced here. Isolating that scenario before changing GetCommandItem or the pinning flow is appropriate; no speculative implementation change or unconditional approval is proposed, and this note-to-self is not treated as an author-wait request.
